policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Jordan visa on arrival
policies.summary: The official Jordan Tourism Board's live nationality table identifies Argentina as eligible to obtain a visa on arrival for 40 JOD.
conditions: Applies to Argentine ordinary-passport short visitors at Jordanian entry points that issue visas on arrival.
The listed single-entry arrival visa fee is 40 JOD; travellers should complete any current pre-arrival registration requested by Jordan.
This policy does not cover work, residence, special travel documents, or final admission.

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Ukraine short-visit visa waiver
policies.summary: The in-force Ukraine–Argentina agreement waives visas for eligible ordinary-passport tourism and other non-remunerated visits for up to 90 days per calendar year.
conditions: Applies to valid Argentine ordinary passports for tourism, transit and other non-remunerated activities.
Visa-free stays are limited to 90 days in a calendar year under the bilateral agreement.
This policy does not cover employment, residence, special travel documents, wartime operational access, or final admission.
